candidates.title: Transmission electron microscopy images and deep Learning-predicted segmentation for statistical analysis of cobalt oxide nanoparticles
candidates.label_origin: hand-labeled training patches and source-model predicted masks; neither is independent external ground truth
source_evidence: Record reports TEM images, deep-learning predicted segmentation, and hand-labeled images used for neural-network training.
Files include TEM_images.zip, Segmented_images.zip, training_images.h5, and training_labels.h5 with repository MD5 values.
candidates.next_validation_step: Exclude from external validation; preserve only as the target training/source-overlap control.

candidates.title: Atomic segmentation of high-resolution transmission electron microscopy images using deep learning
candidates.label_origin: single-human processed segmentation labels reported by the source
source_evidence: Source metadata reports 407 raw HRTEM images and 13 processed image-label pairs across Au, Ag, and CdSe.
The assessed metadata reports one human labeler and one creator name overlapping the target source.
candidates.next_validation_step: Use only for a predeclared cross-material diagnostic after authenticated file audit; never classify it as cobalt-oxide in-domain validation.

candidates.title: Raw data-Three-dimensional nano-framework CoP/Co2P/Co3O4 heterojunction as trifunctional electrocatalyst for metal-air battery and water splitting
source_evidence: The anonymous Mendeley public API exposes database.rar at 3472702 bytes with SHA-256 db3204100545fe3a152c0a545d29ab7f27f85c86594de3e3484bb76020ad7edf.
The separate raw-data DOI 10.17632/zhnbzhjrtr.1 exposes a byte-identical archive, so the two records are not independent datasets.
The verified archive contains 90 members, including two Ceta TIFF files and four HAADF or elemental-map BMP files under publication figure directories.

Both TIFF files are uncompressed 1024 x 1024 RGB 8-bit images and the four BMP files are 512 x 512 RGB rendered images; no pixel calibration, immutable sample or acquisition IDs, Co3O4 region binding, or detector-intensity provenance is available.
candidates.next_validation_step: Exclude this public archive from independent segmentation validation. Acquire or obtain author-released raw cobalt-oxide TEM detector data with immutable sample/acquisition lineage before blinded annotation.

candidates.title: Dataset of Durable, pure-water-fed, anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzers through interphase engineering
source_evidence: Official record describes low-dose cryo-TEM images for cobalt-hydroxide/ionomer systems.
Three TEM TIFF files and repository MD5 values are listed; the images are not cobalt-oxide HRTEM segmentation labels.
candidates.next_validation_step: Verify the record licence and image-level metadata, then consider only a cross-phase annotation-method pilot; do not use it for cobalt-oxide in-domain performance claims.

candidates.title: STEM and XRD files of Water and Hydroxide Trapping in Cobalt Tungstate for Proton Exchange Membrane Water Electrolysis
source_evidence: Official record lists DM3, DM4, EMD, TIFF, and PNG microscopy files with MD5 values under CC-BY-4.0.
The microscopy target is cobalt tungstate; the file named Cobalt Oxide.ras is an XRD reference, not a labeled cobalt-oxide TEM set.
candidates.next_validation_step: Retain only as a cross-phase microscopy robustness source after file audit and independent annotation; it cannot establish cobalt-oxide in-domain generalization.

candidates.title: Physico-chemical characterization of sterilized Co3O4 nanoparticles by XPS / HAXPES / SEM
source_evidence: Official record describes XPS, HAXPES, and SEM measurements for five Co3O4 nanoparticle treatment conditions.
No TEM or HRTEM image set is reported.
candidates.next_validation_step: Exclude from TEM segmentation validation; it may be relevant only to a separate SEM workflow.

candidates.title: PhaseT3M: 3D Imaging at 1.6 Å Resolution via Electron Cryo-Tomography with Nonlinear Phase Retrieval
candidates.reuse_license: dataset record does not explicitly declare a data reuse licence; GPL-3.0 is stated for code only
source_evidence: Official Zenodo metadata describes an approximately 7 nm Co3O4 nanoparticle and a 501 MB raw_tilt_data.zip archive with MD5 efb1e487aedbafa7c0822e0d31968d05.
The source states that released tilt series were motion-corrected and tilt-aligned, and names the relevant member Co3O4_denoised_tilt_series.h5.
The checksum-bound audit inspects the unique HDF5 member while preserving the source declaration that the representation is denoised and processed rather than raw detector data.
Min Gee Cho and Mary Scott overlap the target cobalt-oxide training-source creators, so repository separation does not establish model-development independence.
candidates.next_validation_step: Use only for processed exact-material HDF5 and robustness diagnostics. Request raw detector frames, immutable sample/acquisition lineage, explicit data reuse terms, and an independent multi-sample source before blinded annotation or model evaluation.
